reference.pathophysiology: Lymphocytic killing hollows myocytes into dilated thin sacs while sarcomere mutations thicken septa into obstructing muscle; fibrinous exudates glue pericardial layers that calcify into rigid boxes equalising diastolic pressures.
additionalDifferentials: Myocarditis versus MI by age, prodrome and coronaries
HCM versus athlete heart by disarray and SAM
Tamponade versus constriction by collapse versus knock
additionalInvestigations: Troponin with cardiac MRI in postviral failure
Echo with septal thickness and SAM in dynamic murmurs
Echo diastolic collapse with equalised pressures in pericardial shock
